name: plan-to-tutor
description: Write and revise lesson plans, notes, class tests, revision notes and slides for your own classes with Plan-to-Tutor.

plugins.name: lpcg
plugins.description: Plan-to-Tutor: find your lessons, then write and revise lesson plans, notes and tests for them with the content engine's tools.

plugins.name: lesson-plan
plugins.description: A teacher's lesson plan for one lesson, written by the content engine one curriculum objective at a time.

plugins.name: lesson-note
plugins.description: A teacher's lesson note for one step of a lesson, written by the content engine.

plugins.name: class-test
plugins.description: A short multiple-choice class test on each lesson objective, with its answer key and a misconception code for each wrong option.

plugins.name: revision-note
plugins.description: A revision note for a learner revising a lesson alone at home, one section per lesson objective: the class note, and the note adapted to one learner's marked work.

plugins.name: slide-deck
plugins.description: A teacher's slides for one lesson, written by the content engine from the lesson plan and the approved lesson note.
